title: A landscape with many roles
summaryZh: 多塞特郡Lyscombe获得国家自然保护区认定：保护草地、维持历史遗迹与较低强度农业如何相互联系？
levelReason: 编辑估计B1：从自然景观连接保护方式、农业与水质，使用关系从句、被动语态及因果表达；生物名称配中文，不是官方分级。

source.name: Natural England / GOV.UK
source.title: Rare species help Dorset nature reserve gain national recognition
source.author: Natural England

sentences.text: On 15 September 2026, Natural England announced that Lyscombe in Dorset had become a National Nature Reserve.
sentences.zh: 2026年9月15日，英格兰自然署宣布，多塞特郡的Lyscombe已成为国家自然保护区。

sentences.text: The site covers 334 hectares and lies within the Dorset Downs, a landscape of chalk hills, old woodland and valleys.
sentences.zh: 该地占地334公顷，位于多塞特丘陵之中，那是一片有白垩丘陵、古老林地和山谷的景观。

sentences.text: This wider landscape inspired the novels of Thomas Hardy, so its importance is cultural as well as environmental.
sentences.zh: 这片更广阔的景观曾启发托马斯·哈代创作小说，因此它既有环境价值，也有文化意义。

sentences.text: At Lyscombe, the chalk grassland supports at least six species of orchid, including bee orchids, as well as rare chalkhill blue butterflies.
sentences.zh: Lyscombe的白垩草地支持至少六种兰花，包括蜂兰，以及稀有的白垩蓝蝶。

sentences.text: The announcement explains that nature needs larger, better and more connected spaces if it is to recover.
sentences.zh: 公告解释说，自然要恢复，就需要面积更大、质量更好、联系更紧密的空间。

sentences.text: Lyscombe could help recovery across the wider Dorset Downs, an area of 5,700 hectares; that figure is not the size of the new reserve itself.
sentences.zh: Lyscombe可能有助于整个5700公顷多塞特丘陵地区的恢复；这个数字并非新保护区本身的面积。

sentences.text: Looking after this place involves more than leaving every part of the land untouched.
sentences.zh: 照料这个地方并不只是让每一块土地都完全不受干预。

sentences.text: English Longhorn cattle are introduced to graze, helping to maintain the chalk grassland and prevent bushes from taking over.
sentences.zh: 这里引入英国长角牛放牧，以帮助维持白垩草地，并防止灌木侵占。

sentences.text: This traditional form of conservation works alongside natural regeneration, while protecting the landscape and its historic features.
sentences.zh: 这种传统保护方式与自然更新相结合，同时保护景观及其历史遗存。

sentences.text: These include a medieval chapel, a sixteenth-century house and remains of older settlements.
sentences.zh: 这些遗存包括一座中世纪小教堂、一座16世纪房屋和更古老聚落的遗迹。

sentences.text: Less intensive farming also allows food production to continue, rather than treating farming and nature as completely separate activities.
sentences.zh: 较低强度的农业也使食物生产得以继续，而不是把农业与自然视为完全分离的活动。

sentences.text: According to the announcement, historic pollution entering the local River Piddle has been reduced, improving water quality farther downstream.
sentences.zh: 据公告称，进入当地Piddle河的历史遗留污染已减少，改善了更下游的水质。

sentences.text: Dorset Wildlife Trust acquired the site in partnership with Natural England in 2024, and the reserve was declared through their partnership.
sentences.zh: 多塞特野生动物信托于2024年与英格兰自然署合作取得该地，此次保护区认定也是双方合作的成果。

sentences.text: The new status recognises both the wildlife already present and the role this place can play in a larger recovery effort.
sentences.zh: 新的地位既认可这里已有的野生生物，也认可该地在更大范围恢复行动中能够发挥的作用。

sentences.text: Lyscombe is the sixteenth reserve in the King’s Series, which aims to create or extend twenty-five National Nature Reserves by 2028, linking this local project to a wider national commitment.
sentences.zh: Lyscombe是国王系列中的第十六处保护区；该系列目标是在2028年前建立或扩展二十五处国家自然保护区，把这一地方项目与更广泛的全国承诺联系起来。

words.note: hectares为面积单位hectare复数，334后保留复数；不是体积、重量或时间。
connected修饰spaces，指生态空间相连；过去分词作形容词。
graze是牛吃草；to后用原形，后文说明抑制灌木扩张。
medieval修饰chapel，表示历史时期，不是可移动或临时建筑。
downstream表示沿水流向下游，farther downstream为更下游。

sentences.note: could保留潜力而非完成结果；分号后明确区分保护区与更广阔区域的面积。

questions.text: How can farming and conservation support each other?
questions.zh: 农业与自然保护如何相互支持？

expressions.text: The same land can serve more than one purpose.
expressions.zh: 同一片土地可以有不止一种用途。
expressions.note: 原创口语练习表达，不是来源引语。
